specification.objective: Refresh Magi Desktop screenshots for Pending writes, Stored memory, and History using the real plugin UI with synthetic in-memory data, preserving all existing Hermes profiles and memory files.

requirements.statement: Capture all three pages in an isolated browser harness rendering the repository's actual desktop/plugin.js with synthetic in-memory fixtures only; do not connect to or write any existing Hermes profile or memory store.
Replace the Pending writes and Stored memory screenshots, add a History screenshot, and link all three local images from README with descriptive non-empty alt text.
Extend the enabled README screenshot regression to verify all three local links, PNG signatures, and 1414x994 dimensions, and keep the configured test and coverage gates passing.

acceptance_criteria.statement: CUA visually verifies all three pages of the actual Magi plugin UI using clearly synthetic demo data in a throwaway browser with no access to existing profile or memory files.
README has exactly one descriptive local image link per requested page; each asset is a valid 1414x994 PNG.
The same full test command passes on the clean baseline and final tree, and both enabled POLIS gates pass on the final tree.

invariants.statement: No existing Hermes profile, MEMORY.md, USER.md, pending queue, or durable memory is read or modified for screenshots.
No runtime source, dependency, plugin configuration, or unrelated documentation changes are made.
Harness code, fixtures, browser state, and build output remain outside the repository; only the requested README, screenshot assets, and their regression assertion are retained.

forbidden_states.statement: Any screenshot data comes from an existing Hermes profile, real user memory, or real pending writes.
A screenshot is replaced or claimed verified without rendering and inspecting the actual plugin UI in the isolated browser.
History is omitted, local image links are broken, PNG assets are malformed, or configured gates fail.

inputs.statement: The user requested screenshots for Pending writes, Stored memory, and History, with synthetic browser data and no changes to existing profiles or memories.
The README currently links pending-writes.png and stored-memory.png; the existing regression requires 1414x994 PNGs.

outputs.statement: Three CUA-inspected local PNG screenshots rendered from the actual Magi plugin UI with synthetic data, referenced in README and validated by the enabled suite.

failure_semantics.statement: If the isolated browser cannot render the actual plugin with synthetic data, do not replace screenshots or claim visual validation; report the blocker without accessing existing profiles or memories.
